name: Outer Coastal Plain

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

climate: Seasons this warm ripen Sémillon, Cabernet Franc, Tempranillo, Dolcetto and Merlot fully without cooking off their freshness.

soil.rock: Sand is warm and airy. It drains fast but holds little water, and phylloxera does not thrive in it. Clay holds water well but drains poorly. It stays cool, which slows ripening and keeps acidity up.
soil.top: The topsoil drains fast and warms early in spring. Vines get little water, which keeps crops small and flavors concentrated, but drought bites hard. It is very acid, which locks up nutrients, so growers spread lime to raise the pH.

land: Mostly flat. Easy and cheap to farm by machine, but on still nights cold air settles on flat ground, so spring frost is a bigger risk.

winkler: Good for generous crops of standard to good wine.
